title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode10 First Ever Event

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, I feel like those two are just as serious about surpassing that event as we are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why don't we wait until after hearing them sing before passing judgment? There's no hurry.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just this once. If you really insist on it, then I'll listen to them seriously just this once.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito! Toya!
Make sure you give those two a good thrashing tonight!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That'll all depend on how they perform tonight.
Anyway, we'll see you inside.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: There'll be no more riding her father's coattails after going up against the BAD DOGS. I can't wait to see her get shown up in front of an audience.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: All right, time to get ready to lend my support.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I'm going to have to get up there...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's all right, Kohane. Just take a deep breath.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All we've got to do is be ourselves. Sing the way we want. For today, just enjoy the experience!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next up is the Vivids! They only just recently teamed up, but get this! One of them is the daughter of the famous Ken! You won't want to miss this!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: This'll be my first time hearing her! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An said this was just a small venue, but it feels really big...)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Nice! She's Ken's daughter, alright! This is a really difficult song, but she's killing it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (My part is coming up... I'll be all right. As long as I calm down...and believe in myself!)

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Hehe, I believe it was this cable.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(My voice didn't crack!
I can do this!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, what happened?
Is there something wrong with the equipment?

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Hey, what gives? Things were just getting good...

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Something happen with the sound system?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do we do?!
The music stopped and the mics aren't working!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(This is bad!
If we don't do something, it's going to kill the mood!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She's letting the mood of the room get to her. I can't blame her, though. This is her first event.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (All the more reason I can't let this get ruined.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (If we're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND together, we can't let something like this trip us up!)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: They're going to keep singing without the music?! Man, Ken's daughter doesn't let anything get in her way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I-I've got to sing too! It'll be fine!
I've done plenty of a cappella practice in front of people!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's not your fault. Neither one of us could have known the music would stop like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...after all the help you gave me practicing...
What do you think you're doing?
What's the big deal? You guys were no fans of those two either!
Don't you dare lump us in with your pathetic jealousy! You screwed up the whole event.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Akito, you're the one who said you were going to crush them! The only reason I cut the power was to help you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: ...! Why did you have to turn up now?
